prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, demi-statue demi statue portrait, concentric-ringed crystal/wood/stone body, every seam physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh tips a little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Korean woman in Gangnam-eonni makeup — glowing dewy skin, a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips, long sleek chestnut waves, a poised, refined, confident expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a big rose-gold hoop.

Physique: A colossal heavy chest wider than her shoulders, a waistline that still pulls in sharply, then an enormous belly and colossal wide hips flaring out again, her body in concentric rings, demi-statue

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow. Below this line, there is no bare skin anywhere on her body below this line — every part, without exception, is one of the materials described.

Her whole body below the collarbones is patterned in concentric rings centred on her navel: the innermost ring is solid transparent golden-yellow citrine crystal crystal; the next ring out is carved solid dark wenge wood with fine gold-tan pinstripes, completely opaque; the outermost ring (shoulders, arms, outer hips) is carved solid vivid sky-blue turquoise with dark matrix veining, completely opaque. At every seam where two pieces meet, one edge rises very slightly above its neighbour, casting a thin, crisp shadow — proving each piece is a truly separate object, not a flat pattern painted on one surface. A little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be, her left thigh rounds off into its own small, smooth, satin-polished carved tip (the same innermost golden-yellow citrine crystal crystal ring); her right thigh rounds off into its own small, smooth, satin-polished carved tip (the same innermost golden-yellow citrine crystal crystal ring).

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a soft cream white on one side and a deep forest green on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so white light glances off one side and green light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
